what: SHA-256 of Phase-2's supervised states at the largest label budget (labels only and the graph network, seeds 0-2), as listed on the box's state directory on 22 September 2026, before Phase-2b, which reused these units from the cache (results.e8.metrics.d9_restart.sup_units_from_cache) and read these files as its P3 shared checkpoints.
